purpose: Routed IPv6 release baseline with independent outer-datagram loss and delay-only controls.
method: Persistent daemons within each phase; fresh namespaces between phases. Disjoint CPU placement, no overlapping local builds, kernel tests or Git packing. CPU covers before/sent samples; 100% is one core. Goodput uses receiver sample bytes/time; final missing and counter deltas include two-second drain. Gauges are absolute per-worker after values, never counter deltas. Zero phase has no netem qdisc. Qdisc-left affects R-to-L; qdisc-right affects L-to-R.
counter_units: Queue drops count source buffers or control records; a dropped GSO source can contain many frames. TAP and socket drops count SKBs, expiry counts frame classes. Do not sum them as exact frame losses.

validation.capture_scope: Separate 200-packet functional checks, not full-sweep packet captures.
